title: Evaluation case p3-lisbon-access-rule: people at every office are blocked after a new device-compliance access rule
scenario: People at every office are blocked after a new device-compliance access rule.

events.title: Staff blocked from Teams
events.text: Since Monday morning many of our staff cannot get into Teams. After typing the password they are told that access is blocked by their organisation, or they are asked for a second factor again and again. It affects people at all of our offices, more than a hundred so far.

events.title: Re: Staff blocked from Teams
events.text: Thank you. Please give me the names of three blocked users and, for every one of them, a UTC timestamp at which a sign-in was refused. Also tell me whether any security or access settings were changed shortly before Monday.

events.title: Re: Staff blocked from Teams
events.text: Yes. On Friday afternoon our security team switched on a new access rule that requires a managed, compliant device for Teams. The three users are r.silva 08:02 UTC, c.santos 08:07 UTC and p.costa 08:11 UTC.

events.title: Sign-in log check
events.text: All three failed attempts are in the Entra sign-in logs. Each one is marked as stopped by Conditional Access, by the new device-compliance rule, and one of them also shows an interrupted multi-factor step.

events.title: Service health check
events.text: Looked at the Microsoft service health page and the message centre: there is no incident about sign-in or Teams right now.

events.title: Next step
events.text: The logs point at the new device-compliance rule. Could you exclude one affected test user from that rule and tell me whether signing in works for them afterwards?

events.title: Re: Next step
events.text: We excluded the test user and waited twenty minutes. They are still blocked with the same message.

events.title: Exclusion check
events.text: Looked at the exclusion more closely: the test user was left out of the older rule, not the new one. The block comes from the newer rule.

events.title: Re: Next step
events.text: We left the user out of the new rule as well and sign-in works now. We will adjust the rule for devices that are not enrolled yet.
